text:
maria-run: Heads up: canary to nccl 3.3.0 in us-west3 is showing intermittent allgather hangs on A100 inference pools. Observed under steady traffic, ~30m in. Logs attached.

 tj-infra: which driver / CUDA combo? any kernel diffs in that region?

 maria-run: CUDA 12.1, driver 535.86.10, kernel 6.6.12 in that region. Happens after a while, workers spin in ncclAllGather.

 eli-runtime: saw a blip in eu-west last week but thought it was a fabric flap. Any p2p/PCIe errors in dmesg?

 maria-run: dmesg shows NVRM Xid 79 and repeated `nv_peer` warnings. snippet:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1): 79
[ 12345.679012] nv_peer: peer timeout, retry
[ 12345.679123] nccl INFO transport: allgather timeout
```

 ci-bot: Canary job #142 failed on us-west3-canary (allgather hang)

 tj-infra: assigning to @sam-sre to correlate with host NIC / nvlink counters and kernel traces

 sam-sre: on it, pulling fdatasync, dmesg, and mlx5 counters. early signal: p2p retransmit counts rising right before stalls.

 aaron-ml: could be kernel/driver interaction with latest kernel scheduling. recall region was moved to 6.6.12 last week while others stayed 6.5.x.

 maria-run: confirmed: us-west3 is on 6.6.12, eu-west and us-east still on 6.5. We rolled nccl 3.3 only to canaries in us-west3.

 tj-infra: suggested immediate action: pause nccl 3.3 rollout, revert canaries. do we revert kernel or nccl first? revert nccl rollout first to isolate.

 eli-runtime: also add short-term runtime fallback: if allgather stalls > 8s, route to nccl 3.2 variant or single-gpu path.

 sam-sre: queuing rollback now. I'll also collect `/proc/interrupts`, `ethtool -S` output and nvlink firmware versions.

 maria-run: rollback executed at 2178904600, canary back to nccl 3.2. Monitoring latency.

 ci-bot: Canary rollback completed. tail latency returned to baseline :white_check_mark:

 maria-run: still seeing ~1/1000 hung requests after rollback, digging into KV cache hotpath interactions and retry behavior.

 tj-infra: create postmortem ticket and include kernel/driver/nccl/log bundles + flame graphs + `strace`/`gdb` snippets.

 maria-run: created INFRA-1347 with logs: https://redwood-internal/INFRA-1347

 eli-runtime: follow-ups: add a preflight that runs an allgather stress across kernel+driver+nccl matrix prior to rollout, and gate by nvlink retransmit thresholds.

 sam-sre: sharing firmware matrix and nvlink counters in the ticket, looks like two nodes had older nvlink fw which may affect link-level recovery.

 maria-run: cost note: repeated hangs triggered customer-level retries, ~8% token cost bump in us-west3 during the canary window. adding to the incident summary.

 tj-infra: good to capture for exec sync. holding nccl 3.3 rollout until validated against kernel 6.6.x and fw matrix. :no_entry_sign:

 eli-runtime: copying this thread to #eng-runtime for visibility and to sync on runtime fallback plan.

 maria-run: thanks everyone — will post a short postmortem draft once we've got full traces.
